coolant.source: CoolProp 8.0.0 HEOS::n-Dodecane; freshly evaluated, no reference-data clamping

validity.interpolation: bilinear T,p only when all nonzero-weight corner states are valid; no extrapolation
validity.phaseBoundary: No interpolation across null/vapor states. Valid rectangular cells stay on the dense-liquid side of the saturation boundary.
validity.enthalpy: Absolute values depend on reference state and can be negative; use differences. cp is the EOS derivative at constant pressure.
limitations: Single-component n-dodecane is not an RP-1 mixture model or qualified RP-1 data.
No pyrolysis, coking, boiling or two-phase transport model.
Not an official NIST or REFPROP export.

validation.method: direct CoolProp versus bilinear interpolation at each fully valid cell midpoint
validation.limitation: Interpolation checks only; no evidence of RP-1 surrogate accuracy.
